commercial_product.summary: Operates four divisions: (i) rural hospital (Big South Fork Medical Center via SCCH/RCHI), (ii) mental and behavioral health (Myrtle Recovery Centers — substance use disorder treatment), (iii) information, data and biospecimen sourcing for biotech / clinical research / pharma (Vector BioSource), (iv) epigenetic biomarker diagnostics and interpretation. Revenue derives from healthcare services and biospecimen / data sales rather than proprietary drug or device development.
